services.desc: Let an experienced captain take the helm while you enjoy the stunning Florida scenery with family and friends. Perfect for groups of four, our boats can accommodate up to six people as you cruise around the waters from Key Largo to Islamorada and beyond. And our friendly and knowledgeable guides are happy to personalize the experience for you. Because we pride ourselves on meeting our customers’ needs - whatever they are - our charters run the gamut from two-hour tours to full-day excursions. services.name: Snorkel Tours
services.desc: Our experienced guides will lead you from our location in Islamorada to some of Florida's most beautiful underwater sites. We’ll show you around and share information about the area and all of the wonders you'll see below the surface. Florida is the only place in the continental United States with coral reefs so close to shore, and we have discovered several beautiful examples near our shop. Snorkelers can explore Hens and Chicken Reef, Conch Reef, and Alligator Reef, among others. And if those aren’t enough, you may also see manatees, dolphins, turtles, and other marine life. services.name: boat rental
services.desc: Our Florida Keys rental fleet includes deck boats for leisurely cruises with friends and family, and fishing boats for those who’d rather drop a hook and try to catch the big one. Reef Marine’s convenient location about 25 minutes south of Key Largo provides easy access to the turquoise waters of the Gulf - and all the wildlife that calls it home. Our boats are also pet friendly and equipped with everything you'll need for a day on the water, including safety equipment and snorkel gear. Take the whole family out in a deck boat rental for a relaxing day on the water, soaking in the sights and sounds of nature. Or gather up the gang and rent a fishing vessel for some deep-sea angling.
